parked.reopenIf: Self-blinding fixed, or as part of a batched realism restart.
parked.title: Flash kick (--kick_bot flash --kick_neg 3)
parked.why: Flashes did not pay: the thrower blinded itself ~2.2 ticks per flash and kills of blinded enemies stayed at baseline. Owner dropped it although the written drop rule was not met.

parked.reopenIf: Ramp-in (0 -> 100 % of games) plus a decaying kick toward the bots' carrier / escort / retrieve rules.
parked.title: Bomb carry (one attacker carries and can drop the bomb)
parked.why: Carrier logistics were not learned; fails no-harm and plant-recovery gates.

parked.reopenIf: After the self-blind fix, when flashes are frequent.
parked.title: Flash assist reward together with the kick
parked.why: Nothing to steer while flashes still blind the thrower and don't convert.

parked.reopenIf: When a fresh network is trained (restart, bigger net).
parked.title: Hidden-enemy critic on a fresh network (--critic opp)
parked.why: Gain only for a fresh small network fitting easy features; the trained critic already has them. No A/B run.

parked.reopenIf: When the main line needs a new learning lever: 4e8 x 2 seeds or a fresh copy.
parked.title: Belief loss (predict enemy positions) retest
parked.why: Only a short, early, small-network test exists; never tested in today's game.

parked.reopenIf: A learned belief of where enemies actually stand exists.
parked.title: Search distillation with a learned belief
parked.why: Headroom was hidden information, not decision quality; uniform belief too crude.

parked.reopenIf: Before claiming 'robust' for any agent, or when the main line needs a robustness number.
parked.title: Exploitability probes (calibrated, cross-seed, plan-kick)
parked.why: Labelled inconclusive (lr confound, warm copy only probes its neighbourhood); PCX / PR-2 pilots failed.

parked.reopenIf: Retry on the 2080 Ti or at 128-256 MB.
parked.title: XLA dot-merger flag
parked.why: Blocked by GPU memory; small expected gain; result never recorded.

parked.reopenIf: Fine positioning becomes the limit; then 40x40 + action repeat or a distilled k = 2 agent.
parked.title: Finer world k = 2 (56x56)
parked.why: Cost, and the world is not an exact copy; decision 10-14: stay at 28x28.

parked.reopenIf: Richer observations / 3D, multi-round hidden state, memory-equipped exploiters.
parked.title: Recurrent policy (--rnn GRU)
parked.why: Memory probes found no value (see R22).

parked.reopenIf: Shooting realism becomes next; judge at 4e8.
parked.title: blind_spray and wall_pen (shooting while blind, wallbangs)
parked.why: Not needed so far.

parked.reopenIf: A batched restart (section 3).
parked.title: From-scratch rerun with a bootstrap
parked.why: Sparse reward: a random attacker almost never plants.

parked.reopenIf: Only if flick accuracy proves too weak.
parked.title: Aim settle after a flick
parked.why: Superseded by flick_acc.

parked.reopenIf: A GPU with compute capability >= 8.0.
parked.title: Pallas / Triton GEMM / BF16 on Turing
parked.why: Blocked by the GPUs available (2080 Ti, 1660 Ti).

parked.reopenIf: Finer k = 2 world or denser fights, or adopt for rule realism alone.
parked.title: Stray fire (bullets fly on, friendly fire x0.33)
parked.why: Friendly fire too cheap (~0.1 HP per round per team) to show in the return; nothing to learn.

parked.reopenIf: After the flash and generator changes, if re-scored exploiters still find the holes.
parked.title: Hole-patch A/B (saved exploiters in the pool)
parked.why: Both holes depended on upcoming changes (generator geometry, flash strength).

parked.reopenIf: Owner asks.
parked.title: Viewer next round (observer fog view, scoreboard, radar images)
parked.why: Owner: 'we will do it but later'.

parked.reopenIf: Owner asks; needs a bot check + cost.
parked.title: Longer view range (10 -> 20-28 tiles)
parked.why: Owner: 'defer a bit for now'.

parked.reopenIf: More pro demos are needed than the mirrors give.
parked.title: FACEIT data access
parked.why: Owner: 'drop this'; Hugging Face HLTV mirrors suffice.

parked.reopenIf: With wallbangs (wall_pen > 0) or a milder memory aim.
parked.title: cs3 shooting (memory aim through smoke)
parked.why: Overshoots; CS2's far memory-shot bound is mostly pros spraying walls (89 % wall-blocked). Kept cs v2.

parked.reopenIf: Metric bodies need body-aware bots anyway.
parked.title: 2x2 bodies at k = 2 (body_tiles=2)
parked.why: Inconclusive: 2x2 breaks the scripted bots; 1-2 days of bot fixes; touches env code during the S0 refactor.

parked.reopenIf: Many more dead players per step, or a GPU where rollout forwards dominate.
parked.title: Actor on live rows only (--live_actor 0.85)
parked.why: 0.3 % on the main GPU is not worth a non-exact switch.

parked.reopenIf: Attention over entities becomes necessary, or a cheaper kernel.
parked.title: Shared player-token encoder (network v2)
parked.why: Cost; kept as a default-off option.

parked.reopenIf: A JAX / XLA release that supports stream annotation in loops.
parked.title: Bots on a second GPU stream
parked.why: Blocked by the compiler, not a measurement.

parked.reopenIf: Never (game design settled).
parked.title: Elimination mode (no bomb) as the teamwork test
parked.why: Lone hunters beat every coordinated playbook; teamwork cannot emerge.

parked.reopenIf: A rule set where fights are no longer decisive.
parked.title: More defender time (longer plant / bomb timers)
parked.why: Fights, not time, are the bottleneck.

parked.reopenIf: gamma 0.995 was never run.
parked.title: 2 epochs, gamma 0.997 (M17 A/B)
parked.why: Worse or equal.

parked.reopenIf: A new GPU changes the memory / speed picture.
parked.title: Bigger batch (1,024 / 2,048 games per update)
parked.why: Half as many updates at equal steps; GPU already saturated at 1,024.

parked.reopenIf: A different policy-step knob.
parked.title: Smaller policy step: clip 0.1, 1 epoch
parked.why: Nothing restarts learning; the clip binds on 1.3 % of samples.

parked.reopenIf: Do not retry.
parked.title: Larger learning rate 6e-4
parked.why: Bigger step hurts on both seeds and both map sets.

parked.reopenIf: Not before the line plateaus at 1e-4 with a new recipe.
parked.title: Even smaller learning rate 5e-5
parked.why: Halving again buys nothing.

parked.reopenIf: Per-head entropy floors are a different idea.
parked.title: Higher entropy bonus 0.004
parked.why: Entropy sits at ~0.16 because the game wants it.

parked.reopenIf: None.
parked.title: No value clip (--vclip 0)
parked.why: No effect.

parked.reopenIf: A population diverse enough for weighting to matter.
parked.title: PFSP pool weighting
parked.why: ~0; naive self-play + league-lite wins.

parked.reopenIf: Never as a training bank.
parked.title: Balanced map bank (717 of 2,048 maps)
parked.why: Throwing away two thirds of the maps loses variety.

parked.reopenIf: A mix <= 10 % or retake-only, if defence limits again.
parked.title: Start-state curriculum (30 % hold / retake drills)
parked.why: Drills take ~21 % of steps from full rounds.

parked.reopenIf: A cold or longer run; maps where far cover matters.
parked.title: Far view (coarse walls to 10 tiles, +98 inputs)
parked.why: Inputs reached the network but nothing improved in 1e8 steps.

parked.reopenIf: None (real CS maps are test-only); revisit <= 5 % after generator v3 (notebook 11-01).
parked.title: Training on 4 real CS maps
parked.why: Memorisation: more training hurts the unseen map.

parked.reopenIf: If the target becomes 'beat bots'.
parked.title: More scripted-bot share or a bot-only policy
parked.why: Beating the bots' engine does not carry to learned opponents; 20 % is the only free dose.

parked.reopenIf: A competent or kickstarted attacker start.
parked.title: Cold-start / run-lr exploiters
parked.why: No learning signal against a strong agent without a curriculum.

parked.reopenIf: Row superseded by the U2 P0 adoption.
parked.title: Drop the co-trained exploiter
parked.why: First test lost on the unseen map; later reversed (UPDATE 10-21 11:53, adopted 10-21 14:57).

parked.reopenIf: An opponent family where plans really differ.
parked.title: Plan-ID input (opponent's plan one-hot)
parked.why: One policy already beats all 5 plans.

parked.reopenIf: A longer run or two heads.
parked.title: Opponent-type flag (bot vs learned)
parked.why: One network does not learn two modes from one input.

parked.reopenIf: Not needed.
parked.title: Facing-line molotov
parked.why: The throw lands where the agent walks next; replaced by aimed molotovs (+49, +79 Elo).

parked.reopenIf: See P5.
parked.title: Belief head in the old game
parked.why: Seed 0's hint was noise.

parked.reopenIf: Richer observation / 3D.
parked.title: GRU / history as a fix for defence
parked.why: Hand-built team memory already carries what history adds.

parked.reopenIf: An 'own observation + true state' critic was never tried.
parked.title: MAPPO shared global-state critic
parked.why: Grouped agents get shot from the side.

parked.reopenIf: Observations stop carrying teammates' state.
parked.title: Team-information critic
parked.why: Observations already carry the team's shared memory.

parked.reopenIf: See P4.
parked.title: Hidden-enemy critic, warm-started
parked.why: The trained critic already infers what hidden enemies add.

parked.reopenIf: From-scratch or richer-observation run, at equal compute.
parked.title: Residual blocks (deeper nets)
parked.why: Capacity is not the limit; costs speed.

parked.reopenIf: A new agent family or very different observations.
parked.title: Re-distillation / wider fresh copies at the plateau
parked.why: No plasticity or capacity gain at this width.

parked.reopenIf: Not needed.
parked.title: Distillation v1 (fading KL during RL)
parked.why: Too few gradient updates; coefficient decayed too early. Fixed by a supervised copy first.

parked.reopenIf: Value accuracy becomes the visible limit.
parked.title: Critic-only refresh (fresh distilled critic)
parked.why: Dormant critic units are not what slows learning.

parked.reopenIf: Unclear.
parked.title: Top-25 %-advantage filter
parked.why: Unclear.

parked.reopenIf: A bootstrap (P12).
parked.title: Plain from-scratch rerun
parked.why: Sparse-reward collapse.

parked.reopenIf: Never as is.
parked.title: Flash v1 free-grenade curriculum
parked.why: The free stage taught 'throw freely' and 4e8 more steps didn't unlearn it.

parked.reopenIf: A new rare action whose payoff is immediate.
parked.title: Cost randomisation of own-grenade effects
parked.why: Agents never learn the follow-up, so even free flashes have no payoff.

parked.reopenIf: See P1.
parked.title: Flash kick v1 (one-sided)
parked.why: No 'don't throw here' rows: flashing generalised to every state. Fixed by P1's two-sided kick.

parked.reopenIf: Only with something that makes flashes frequent (P3).
parked.title: Flash assist reward alone
parked.why: A pruned action never produces the reward that would teach it.

parked.reopenIf: A game change that makes walking matter (footstep range, listeners, half-speed cost).
parked.title: Walk override / walk kick / scripted walk target
parked.why: Bolting a rule onto a trained agent breaks its timing; most silent approaches are already known.

parked.reopenIf: See P7.
parked.title: Co-trained exploiter as a robustness tool
parked.why: Buys Elo but no measured robustness; benefit comes from near-copies in the pool.

parked.reopenIf: See P6.
parked.title: One-step search with a uniform belief
parked.why: The oracle's headroom is hidden information.

parked.reopenIf: Only if anchor-game sampling becomes the question.
parked.title: Dropping the speed flag --anchor_static 2
parked.why: The flag costs ~1 Elo at most and buys ~1.3-1.4x speed.

parked.reopenIf: A new GPU class.
parked.title: Command buffers incl. WHILE; cloud BF16
parked.why: Training is game play, not learning, on these GPUs.

parked.reopenIf: A kick decaying over the whole life, on half the games, or longer lives.
parked.title: PCX: plan-clone co-trained exploiters
parked.why: A kick strong enough to move style wipes the exploiter's skill.

parked.reopenIf: A kick on a fixed fraction of games, longer decay, or frozen fire / target heads.
parked.title: PR-2: plan-kick exploiters as a robustness probe
parked.why: Same wall as R40: copying a plan wipes fighting skill.

parked.reopenIf: Opponents that buy like pros and a reason to beat them per round (humans), or a game change that makes eco pay.
parked.title: Learned buying (E3 learner)
parked.why: A learned head would only rediscover a fixed policy.

parked.reopenIf: Much larger budget, faster early learning, or a rule change the warm line can't absorb; route D untested.
parked.title: Fail-fast restart, route K
parked.why: Learns fast early, then ~2-3 Elo per block: ~50 more blocks to catch up.

parked.reopenIf: A reason to optimise buys against pro-like human teams.
parked.title: Scripted buy rule 'FULL every round' (5v5)
parked.why: Wins rounds vs a pro-rule team but doesn't train stronger players; deletes eco / force rounds.

parked.reopenIf: A behaviour target that needs holders (metric world's fight clock).
parked.title: Holding bot personas
parked.why: No measurable gain.

parked.reopenIf: Longer horizons that matter (full matches with economy pressure).
parked.title: Round gamma 1.0 (no in-round discount)
parked.why: No gain.

parked.reopenIf: The metric world's own sight (MC13) replaces it.
parked.title: Training on S1 fine-sight tables (S1-train)
parked.why: Worse in its own read, costly; verdict STOP.

parked.reopenIf: A hand-written fused (Warp) kernel measured against XLA.
parked.title: Exact-but-slower speed ideas
parked.why: Fewer kernels is not always faster; scheduling flags hurt.

parked.reopenIf: A critic that clearly underfits, or a much cheaper critic pass.
parked.title: The PPG critic-only pass (--critic_epochs 1)
parked.why: Not worth its time; dropped from the v3 line.
